items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It's Bud Scott and Bert Cobbs there. They sounded good there to me. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Stomp Evans, Don and Bonnie Begard.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was Don and Howard. I know he's style of playing there. That's Don now.
It's Bud Scott and Bert Cobbs there. They sounded good there to me.
Yeah. Stomp Evans, Don and Bonnie Begard.
